title: Largest deserts
measure: Area in square km. A desert is any region that gets very little rain or snow, usually under 250 mm a year, so the ice of Antarctica and the Arctic counts. Desert edges are blurry, so apart from Antarctica these areas are estimates and sources differ, sometimes by a lot.

entries.name: Antarctic
entries.note: The whole continent: a desert because so little snow falls, not because it's hot.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of deserts by area

entries.name: Arctic
entries.country: Canada, Greenland, Russia, Norway, USA and others
entries.note: Its size depends on where the Arctic is taken to end.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of deserts by area

entries.name: Sahara
entries.country: Algeria, Libya, Egypt, Mali, Niger, Chad and others
entries.note: The largest hot desert. Some sources give 9.0 million km².
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of deserts by area

entries.name: Great Australian
entries.note: Not one desert but a group of ten, including the Great Victoria, Great Sandy and Gibson. Wikipedia counts them together; most top 10 lists count them separately, and then none of them make the top 10.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of deserts by area
